title: Dimmable Lamp
description: A lamp powered by a smart plug. Its brightness can be set only while powered on; setting it while off is a no-op with success false. `poweredOn` is written by the plug (a cross-Thing effect), and a per-instance link points at that plug.

poweredOn.title: Powered On
poweredOn.description: Whether the lamp has power; written by the plug that controls it.

setBrightness.title: Set Brightness
setBrightness.description: Set the brightness; only takes effect while the lamp is powered on.
setBrightness.vre:effects: brightness' = poweredOn ? level : brightness; output.success = poweredOn; output.brightness = brightness';
